d: In this video, I travel to a random village in China that I discovered only last night. I knew almost nothing about this place before coming here, which made the journey even more exciting. With no expectations and no detailed plan, I took a train into rural China to see what I would find. What awaited me was one of the most beautiful villages I’ve ever visited, surrounded by stunning scenery and authentic local life. Even the stay I booked turned out to be unbelievably beautiful easily one of the best places I’ve ever stayed. Join me as I explore this hidden corner of China and experience…
